title: Fully quantum training of parametric circuits with Quantum Hamiltonian Descent
abstract: arXiv:2610.33144v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parametric quantum circuits are usually trained by classical, local optimizers, which use the quantum computer only to evaluate the cost function, or its gradient, one point at a time. Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) takes a different route: in this quantum algorithm for continuous optimization, the parameters become the position of a quantum particle, with the cost function as its potential, and two time schedules control kinetic and potential energy so that the wavefunction explores the whole landscape and tunnels towards the global minimum. QHD, however, assumes a classically computable cost function, and its digital implementation is poorly understood: standard error bounds grow exponentially with the number of qubits per parameter, and the schedules are borrowed from classical optimization. translated_title: 基于量子哈密顿下降的参数化电路全量子训练
translated_abstract: 参数化量子电路通常由经典的局部优化器进行训练，这些优化器仅利用量子计算机逐点评估代价函数或其梯度。量子哈密顿下降采用了一条不同的路线：在这一用于连续优化的量子算法中，参数被视为一个量子粒子的位置，代价函数则作为其势能，通过两个时间调度来控制动能和势能，使波函数能够探索整个参数空间地形并通过量子隧穿效应趋向全局最小值。然而，QHD假设代价函数可以在经典计算机上计算，而且其数字化实现尚未被充分理解：标准误差界随每个参数所需的量子比特数呈指数增长，并且其时间调度也是借鉴自经典优化方法。本文提出完全在量子计算机上使用QHD来训练参数化电路，通过一个在线步骤，其中编码……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出将量子哈密顿下降（QHD）完全在量子计算机上实现，从而突破QHD原本依赖经典可计算代价函数的限制，实现参数化量子电路的全量子训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fully quantum implementation of Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) to train parametric quantum circuits entirely on a quantum computer, overcoming QHD's previous reliance on classically computable cost functions.
